facts.fact: The DRC Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy signed an MoU with Uganda's Ministry of ICT and National Guidance on 11 May 2026 on digital transformation, connectivity, cybersecurity and digital skills, per Uganda's ministry.

Uganda's Ministry of ICT and National Guidance signed an MoU with the DRC Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy on 11 May 2026 on digital transformation, connectivity, cybersecurity and digital skills.
